title: Clash of the Trackers: Measuring the Evolution of the Online Tracking Ecosystem
reasoning: The paper measures web tracking activity and the impact of privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy). While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper's focus is a technical measurement and analysis of the ecosystem's evolution rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or faith-based aspects. It observes the effects of regulations but does not benchmark ethics itself.
